sections.text: مقدمة

This document 
outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed on an annually 
bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first
draft initiated by eng. Eid Lotfy Tolba, tested by eng. Ebrahim Youssef Abd El 
Latif, revised by EDEPC quality control eng Adel Abdel Qader El Nagar and eng. 
Saad Mahmoud Bassuny, accepted by general director eng. 
Sayed Mahmoud 
Hessain Farag 
and approved 
by eng. 
مختار عبد اللطيف 
ماضي قطاع رأس عتاقة 
PS.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس. سمير عبد الجليل؛ منسق EDEPC MPIS ومعتمد 
 بقلم المحاسب محمود سليمان مدير عام EDEPC 
 التفتيش المالي ومشرف رئيس التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة 
 القطاع.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued, the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety ID category

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بالمكان 
 منطقة العمل مطلوبة

Safety and healthy equipment must be used as 
 safety shoes, and safety Helmet ... etc.
مطلوب العزلة والتأريض السليم

Before 
 starting any work on the machine, check that it is switched off and blocked up 
 for switching on again

sections.text: الأدوات والمعدات
Safety and healthy equipment.
Tool set for tightness, cleaning tools as cloth.... etc
Press-on and detaching device.
Air blower.
العمل المراد تنفيذه

Inspect the electrical cubical and clean by air blower: air pressure 
 less than 3 bar.
فحص المحركات الكهربائية.
Clean the hydrogen unit
Check the electric cubical contactors, timers.
Check the motors, and fan.

Inspect the hydrogen unit transformer, check the carbon brushes, 
 and change it if needed .
